$Classic Controller
*By quatric
*Super Mario Galaxy 2 (Europe/Australia) (SB4P01)
*Play with a Classic Controller plugged into the Wii Remote: left stick moves, right stick aims the cursor.
*A jump, B crouch/ground pound, X/Y spin attack, ZR shoot star bits, L/ZL crouch/long jump, R reset camera.
* Classic Controller driver routines
